description: Cash Flow Analysis (NPV, IRR, MIRR) — Offline capital-budgeting math: flows= comma-separated cash flows starting at period 0 (investment negative), rate= discount rate % per period (default 10). Optional reinvest= and finance_rate= (MIRR), period=year|quarter|month|week|day (annualizes IRR). Returns NPV, IRR (all IRRs when signs change more than once), MIRR, profitability index, payback and discounted payback, equivalent annuity, accept/reject and a per-period PV schedule. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_cashflow
